1.synopsis: Iselde Varn arrives at the Saltmere School, where Corrow Penhallow gives her the Tidewatcher elixir and she enters the first circle.

entities.name: Iselde Varn
entities.summary: A new student at the Saltmere School.

entities.name: Corrow Penhallow
entities.summary: A teacher at the Saltmere School.

entities.name: Saltmere School
entities.summary: A school on a spit of black rock where the tide runs through the cellars.

entities.name: Tidewatcher
entities.summary: The first circle of the Saltmere School.

entities.name: Tidewatcher elixir
entities.summary: A grey drink that smells of kelp and iron.

facts.claim: Tidewatcher is Circle 1 of the Saltmere School.
The Tidewatcher elixir smells of kelp and iron.
quotes: a cup of grey liquid that smelled of kelp and iron
Iselde Varn came to the Saltmere School at the end of the herring season

2.synopsis: Iselde learns that Corrow is a Brine Warden and sees the Brine Warden elixir.

entities.name: Corrow Penhallow
entities.summary: A teacher who sleeps in a hammock over the flooded cellar.

entities.name: Brine Warden
entities.summary: A rank of the Saltmere School that can hold a wave still.

entities.name: Brine Warden elixir
entities.summary: A green flask kept in a locked chest in the cellar.

facts.claim: Brine Warden is Circle 2 of the Saltmere School.
quotes: Brine Warden is Circle 2 of the Saltmere School.

facts.claim: Only Corrow has the key to the chest that holds the Brine Warden elixir.
quotes: The Brine Warden elixir was kept in a locked chest in the cellar, and only Corrow had the key.

3.synopsis: Hennet Larrow of the Gloam School visits Corrow and explains that Gloam names both her school and its first circle.

entities.name: Hennet Larrow
entities.summary: A visitor from the Gloam School.

entities.name: Gloam
entities.summary: A school in the hills beyond the marsh, named after its first circle.

entities.name: Wickbearer elixir
entities.summary: A brew of the Gloam School, now made with beeswax.

facts.claim: Gloam is the name of the school and of its first circle.
quotes: Gloam is the name of our school and the name of its first circle
she had come from the Gloam School in the hills beyond the marsh

4.synopsis: Hennet names the four circles of the Gloam School and says she stands at the third.

entities.name: Hennet Larrow
entities.summary: A visitor from the Gloam School who stands at its third circle.

entities.name: Lantern School
entities.summary: A school over the marsh with circles of its own.

entities.name: Lampwright
entities.summary: The first circle of the Lantern School.

entities.name: Lamplighter
entities.summary: A bright brew of the Lantern School.

facts.claim: Hennet does not expect to climb higher than the third circle.
quotes: I stand at the third, and I do not expect to climb any higher.

facts.claim: Lampwright is the first circle of the Lantern School.
quotes: Lampwright is the first circle of the Lantern School

facts.claim: The Circle 2 elixir of the Lantern School is Lamplighter.
quotes: the Circle 2 elixir of the Lantern School is Lamplighter

5.synopsis: Corrow reveals the third circle of Saltmere during the spring storms.

entities.name: Corrow Penhallow
entities.summary: A teacher who has reached the last known circle of Saltmere.

entities.name: Drowned Choir
entities.summary: A circle of Saltmere told of in stories.

facts.claim: Corrow shouted the name of the circle into the gale.
quotes: heard him shout the name of the circle into the gale

facts.claim: Drowned Choir is Circle 4 of the Saltmere School.
quotes: Drowned Choir is Circle 4 of the Saltmere School

6.synopsis: A letter from Hennet tells of two new schools in the hills, Kestrel and Thornwick, and their first circles.

entities.name: Hennet Larrow
entities.summary: A teacher of the Gloam School who writes to Corrow.

entities.name: Kestrel
entities.summary: A new school in the hills, named after its first door.

entities.name: Hawk Warden
entities.summary: The second circle of Kestrel, which no student has reached.

entities.name: Thornwick
entities.summary: A new school in the hills that keeps two circles.

facts.claim: Every student of Kestrel begins as a Kestrel.
quotes: every student of Kestrel begins as a Kestrel
The Circle 2 that follows Kestrel is Hawk Warden
